_comment: Functional security test suite (T2). Complements SAST: verifies BEHAVIOR (auth required, validation, headers), not just patterns. Every test graceful-skips when the app/dependency is absent.
name: security-tests
description: Functional security pytest suite: auth-required, input validation, SQLi payloads, security headers, plaintext-secret scan. Applies with apply_template; each test skips gracefully.

variables.name: package_name
variables.description: Project package with a FastAPI app (skips when absent)

notes: SAST finds patterns; these verify behavior. test_security_headers FAILS when the app lacks X-Content-Type-Options/X-Frame-Options — that is the intended gate behavior; the fix is adding the middleware. Apply this template after the first green run and keep the suite growing.
